title: The Sleeping Knight
text: In a ring of thorns, a knight in old armor sleeps on a stone bier, his sword on his chest, dust thick on his visor. The stories say he will wake for the realm's last battle. The thorns are pulled back, as if someone has tried before.

options.label: The Leader wakes the knight. If this is not the last battle, it is close enough.

outcomes.text: He wakes, fights beside you, and goes back to sleep after.
He wakes, and thinks you are the enemy.

options.label: Leave an offering and guard his sleep a while, as the stories would want.

outcomes.text: He sighs in his sleep, and you feel braver for it.

options.label: The quietest hands lift the sword from his chest. He will not need it yet.
